# Dependency Injection

**Stable ID:** `pattern.dependency-injection`  
**Kind:** `design-pattern`  
**Status:** `stable`  
**Source:** `skill/references/design-patterns/dependency-injection.md`

## Purpose

Supply collaborators explicitly at construction or call boundaries so lifecycle and substitution remain visible.

## Use when

- A component has infrastructure collaborators or multiple implementations.
- Tests need deterministic substitutes without global mutation.

## Avoid when

- A service locator or container would hide ownership.
- Simple pure functions have no collaborators to inject.

## Applicability

- **Languages:** `any`, `python`, `q-kdbplus`, `cpp`, `rust`, `dart-flutter`, `typescript`
- **Related entries:** `component.configuration`
